{{Top|leg}}
The '''HeadBanger''' was a riot gun used by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] in the wake of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Considered the ultimate in crowd control, its powerful [[Stun blaster/Legends|stun blasts]] could stun any beings of any size, including a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]. [[Human/Legends|Humans]] who sustained even a glancing hit were typically left unconscious for three to four days.
